title: Bethe Ansatz without Nesting
summary: We develop a non-nested Bethe ansatz description of rational $\mathfrak{gl}_\ell$ spin chains in the vector representation. Starting from the quantum spectral curve and the separation-of-variables framework, we derive closed systems of Bethe equations involving only the momentum-carrying Bethe roots. The construction is worked out explicitly for the $\mathfrak{gl}_3$ and $\mathfrak{gl}_4$ spin chains and then generalized to arbitrary rank.
